(Preference will be given to NTC holder)

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Govt. Industrial Training Institute, Dhenkanal (ITI Dhenkanal) in the state of Odisha for selecting qualified professionals.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Guest Instructor (Solar Technician Electrical) under the engineering and technical vocational training domain at ITI Dhenkanal.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Guest Instructor (Solar Technician Electrical) position in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for this job?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 30 September 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the shortlisted candidates is scheduled to be held on 01 October 2026 as per the recruitment guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly offline. Interested candidates need to download the form, fill it, and send it via post or submit it as instructed.

faq.question: Q7. What educational qualification is required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Voc/Degree or 3-year Diploma in Electrical/Electrical and Electronics Engineering with 1 year experience, or NTC/NAC in Solar Technician (Electrical) with 3 years experience.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category, including General, OBC, SC, and ST candidates applying for this position.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: This is a contractual government job opportunity offered by the Industrial Training Institute in Dhenkanal, Odisha.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website to download the notification?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website at www.govtittidkl.co.in to download the notification and application form details.
